name: Fade & Co.
description: Vintage barbershop site with a spinning barber pole, a typewriter service ticker, live walk-in status and a chalkboard price menu.
features: CSS barber pole with seamless rotating stripes in the hero
Typewriter line cycling through the shop's services
Live open/closed walk-in status with today's hours highlighted
Chalkboard service menu with dotted price leaders, barber profiles and booking form
signature: A brass-capped barber pole spins in the hero while a typewriter cycles 'Skin fades.', 'Hot towel shaves.' and more
